name: reflector
description: Fetch and rank Arch Linux mirrors

name: -h
--help
options.description: Show this help message and exit

options.name: --connection-timeout
options.description: The number of seconds to wait before a connection times out

options.name: --download-timeout
options.description: The number of seconds to wait before a download times out

options.name: --list-countries
options.description: Display a table of the distribution of servers by country

options.name: --cache-timeout
options.description: The cache timeout in seconds for the data retrieved from the Arch Linux Mirror Status API

options.name: --url
options.description: The URL from which to retrieve the mirror data in JSON format

options.name: --save
options.description: Save the mirrorlist to the given path

options.name: --sort
options.description: Sort the mirrorlist. "age": last server synchronization

options.name: --threads
options.description: Use n threads for rating mirrors

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print extra information to STDERR

options.name: --info
options.description: Print mirror information instead of a mirror list

name: -a
--age
options.description: Only return mirrors that have synchronized in the last n hours. n may be an integer or a decimal number

options.name: --delay
options.description: Only return mirrors with a reported sync delay of n hours or less, where n is a float

name: -c
--country
options.description: Restrict mirrors to selected countries

name: -f
--fastest
options.description: Return the n fastest mirrors that meet the other criteria

name: -i
--include
options.description: Include servers that match <regex>, where <regex> is a Python regular express

name: -x
--exclude
options.description: Exclude servers that match <regex>, where <regex> is a Python regular express

name: -l
--latest
options.description: Limit the list to the n most recently synchronized servers

options.name: --score
options.description: Limit the list to the n servers with the highest score

name: -n
--number
options.description: Return at most n mirrors

name: -p
--protocol
options.description: Match one of the given protocols, e.g. "https" or "ftp"

options.name: --completion-percent
options.description: Set the minimum completion percent for the returned mirrors

options.name: --isos
options.description: Only return mirrors that host ISOs

options.name: --ipv4
options.description: Only return mirrors that support IPv4

options.name: --ipv6
options.description: Only return mirrors that support IPv6
